originalTitle: Wall Street Has Never Faced This Many Market Forces at Once, NYSE Veteran Says
summary: NYSE veteran Peter Tuchman says oil, two wars, the Fed, and AI spending are hitting Wall Street at once. This has never happened before.
content: NYSE veteran Peter Tuchman says oil, two wars, the Fed, and AI spending are hitting Wall Street at once. This has never happened before.
chineseTitle: 纽约证券交易所资深人士表示，华尔街从未同时面临过如此多的市场力量
chineseSummary: 纽约证券交易所资深人士彼得·塔奇曼表示，石油、两场战争、美联储和人工智能支出正在同时冲击华尔街。这以前从未发生过。
